lines.en: label yukidate25:
scene yukibikeride1
: Are you sure you’re okay with doing this for me? Because I know it’s a pretty big ask.
lines.zh: : 你确定愿意替我做这件事吗？因为我知道这要求挺过分的。

lines.en: : Ain’t nothin’ I haven't done a million times before. Don’t worry about it.
lines.zh: : 这又不是我没干过一百万次的事。别担心。

lines.en: : Thank you, Yuki. And if there’s anything I can do to pay you back, let me know.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Yuki。如果有什么我能做的来报答你，尽管说。

lines.en: : I mean...you can literally pay me. That would work.
lines.zh: : 我是说……你可以直接付我钱。那也行。

lines.en: : If there is anything else I can do to pay you back, let me know.
lines.zh: : 我是说除了这个之外，还有什么我能做的来报答你，尽管说。

lines.en: : What’s going on? Sara trying to coerce sexual favors out of you again?
lines.zh: : 怎么回事？Sara 又想从你这儿讹性服务了？

lines.en: scene yukibikeride2
: Hah...{i}no.{/i} I gave up on that months ago.
lines.zh: : 哈……{i}没有{/i}。那事我几个月前就放弃了。

lines.en: if sarasex == True:
: No offense, Sensei. You’re an exceptional bedroom partner and I wouldn’t trade our moments of intimacy for the world...but Yuki is {i}Yuki.{/i}
lines.zh: : 无意冒犯，Sensei。你是极其出色的床伴，我也绝不会拿我们之间的亲密时刻去换任何东西……可 Yuki 就是 {i}Yuki{/i}。

lines.en: : There are simply some things a woman can do to another woman that a man would never be able to. And Yuki seems to have missed the memo that everyone is bisexual in 2020.
lines.zh: : 有些女人能对另一个女人做的事，是男人永远做不到的。而 Yuki 似乎没收到那份「2020 年人人都是双性恋」的通知。

lines.en: else:
: You know, back in the old day, {i}everyone{/i} wanted a piece of this. Now, {i}no one{/i} does and it’s making me very self-conscious.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，以前{i}大家{/i}都想分我一杯羹。现在{i}没人{/i}想了，这让我非常没有自信。

lines.en: : Yo. You ain’t got shit going on tonight, do you? Could use some help with something.
lines.zh: : 喂。你今晚没什么事吧？有件事需要帮个忙。

lines.en: : Is it the thing Sara just asked for {i}your{/i} help with? Because I’m still not convinced it isn’t sexual.
lines.zh: : 是 Sara 刚请{i}你{/i}帮忙的那件事吗？因为我还是不确信那件事跟性无关。

lines.en: : Just some work shit. Reason she’s bein’ all thankful is my shift already ended.
lines.zh: : 就是点工作上的破事。她那么感恩戴德，是因为我的班已经结束了。

lines.en: scene yukibikeride3
: And with the amount of money I’ve been pumping back into the business lately, I can’t really afford to pay Yuki overtime.
lines.zh: : 而且考虑到我最近把多少钱倒贴回店里，我实在付不起 Yuki 的加班费。

lines.en: : What does she need to do exactly? Because I think you guys may have pushed the whole handing out fliers thing as far as it can go.
lines.zh: : 她到底需要做什么？因为我觉得传单那套你们已经推到极限了。

lines.en: : Gotta go pick up some machine or whatever. Ain’t a problem. Moved plenty of shit back when I was a drifter.
lines.zh: : 去取个什么机器之类的。不是问题。我还是流浪汉的时候搬过的东西多了去了。

lines.en: : Isn’t Yuki the coolest? Like, who can actually say “back when I was a drifter” and be serious about it?
lines.zh: : Yuki 是不是超酷？说真的，谁能一脸严肃地说出「我还是流浪汉的时候」这种话？

lines.en: : It becomes a little less cool when you realize half of that shit probably didn’t belong to her and was pawned off so she could get high.
lines.zh: : 等你意识到那堆东西大概有一半不属于她、而是被她当掉换毒品的，就没那么酷了。

lines.en: : Hey, there was other shit. I bought food too. And bike parts. You’re underestimating just how cheap drugs are, man.
lines.zh: : 嘿，还有别的东西呢。我也买过吃的。还有摩托车零件。你太低估毒品有多便宜了，老兄。

lines.en: : Would you mind going with her? I feel bad making Yuki lug a whole appliance all the way back here by herself.
lines.zh: : 你介意跟她一起去吗？让 Yuki 一个人把一整台电器一路搬回来，我过意不去。

lines.en: : Ain’t like this guy’ll be much help. Might look kinda big, but I’ve run into plenty of guys even bigger than him who wound up being total fuckin’ pansies.
lines.zh: : 这家伙大概也帮不上什么忙。看着块头挺大，可我见过比他还大的男人，结果全是他妈的软蛋。

lines.en: : I’ll go if Yuki promises to stop insulting me.
lines.zh: : 要是 Yuki 答应不再损我，我就去。

lines.en: scene yukibikeride4
: What? It ain’t an insult if it’s the truth. If you’re gonna bring up the drugs, I’m gonna bring up how your bones are probably made out of marshmallows or some shit.
lines.zh: : 什么？如果是事实就不算损。你要提毒品，我就要提你的骨头大概是棉花糖做的什么的。

lines.en: : Well, it sounds like my only choice is to tag along and show you just how much of a man I am.
lines.zh: : 行吧，看来我唯一的选择就是跟着去，让你看看我有多男人。

lines.en: scene yukibikeride5
: Just don’t show her {i}too{/i} much or I will be very jealous! And remember that it takes significantly less to impress me!
lines.zh: : 只是别给她看{i}太{/i}多，我会非常吃醋的！而且要记住，让我印象深刻需要的可少得多！

lines.en: : I am well aware, Sara. But thank you for reminding me.
lines.zh: : 我很清楚，Sara。不过还是谢谢你提醒我。

lines.en: : Ready to hit the road, then? Should get a move on now before it gets too late. Gotta go all the way downtown to pick this shit up.
lines.zh: : 那准备出发了？趁天还没太黑得赶紧走。这破玩意儿得一路开到市中心去取。

lines.en: : Downtown? But how are we going to-
lines.zh: : 市中心？可我们要怎么——

lines.en: : Follow me outside and I’ll show you.
lines.zh: : 跟我出来，我给你看。

lines.en: scene black
Yuki didn’t get a car, did she?
lines.zh: Yuki 该不会弄了辆车吧？

lines.en: The apartment is one thing — and a thing I was able to overlook for the most part seeing as it is not a very {i}nice{/i} apartment.
lines.zh: 公寓是一回事——而且大部分时候我也能睁一只眼闭一只眼，毕竟那不是什么{i}好{/i}公寓。

lines.en: But a car? In a city with cheap, functional public transportation? No wonder Sara isn’t able to pay her for overtime if her wage has gone up that much.
lines.zh: 可车？在一座公共交通便宜又好用的城市？怪不得 Sara 付不起她加班费，如果她的工资涨了那么多的话。

lines.en: The two of us step outside of the bar as Sara slips back into work-mode and attempts to hold down the fort while her only other employee tonight is away.
lines.zh: 我们俩走出酒吧，Sara 切回工作模式，试图在今晚唯一的另一名员工不在时守住店。

lines.en: But considering Yuki’s shift already ended, Sara probably knows-
lines.zh: 不过考虑到 Yuki 的班已经结束了，Sara 大概知道——

lines.en: : Wait, what the fuck is this?
lines.zh: : 等等，这他妈是什么东西？

lines.en: scene yukibikeride6
: My pride and joy, obviously.
lines.zh: : 我的骄傲与喜悦，显然。

lines.en: : Your pride and joy has double D’s and anger issues. This is a motorcycle.
lines.zh: : 你的骄傲与喜悦有着 double D 的胸和暴躁脾气。这是一辆摩托车。

lines.en: : Why even ask if you already know what it is, fucker?
lines.zh: : 你他妈既然知道这是什么，还问什么？

lines.en: : Aren’t we going to pick up some appliance or something? How are we supposed to do that on a motorcycle?
lines.zh: : 我们不是要去取电器什么的吗？骑摩托车怎么取？

lines.en: scene yukibikeride7
: This ain’t just a {i}motorcyle,{/i} man. It’s an 1,100 cc-
lines.zh: : 这可不只是一辆{i}摩托车{/i}，老兄。这是 1,100 cc 的——

lines.en: : Yuki, I’m going to cut you off right there as I can already tell I’m not going to understand anything you’re about to say. The moral of the story is that I’m not riding that. The end. See you later.
lines.zh: : Yuki，我就在这儿打断你，因为我已经能预感到你接下来要说的话我一个字都听不懂。故事的寓意是：我不骑那玩意儿。完毕。回头见。

lines.en: scene yukibikeride8
: What happened to showin’ me how much of a man you are, huh? You a little pussy ass bitch after all? Worried you’re gonna get a boo-boo?
lines.zh: : 说好的要让我看看你有多男人呢，嗯？你果然是个小屁眼娘们？怕自己会擦破点皮？

lines.en: : I’m worried I’m going to {i}die.{/i} Not to mention how there is literally no way we’ll be able to-
lines.zh: : 我是怕自己会{i}死{/i}。更别提我们根本没有办法——

lines.en: scene yukibikeride9
: Relax, man. Ain’t nothin’ to be scared about. Been riding for almost as long as I’ve been walking. You’re safe with me.
lines.zh: : 放松点，老兄。没什么好怕的。我骑车的年头几乎和我走路的年头一样长。跟我在一起很安全。

lines.en: : Plus, ain’t a way in hell I’d let anything happen to my baby.
lines.zh: : 再说了，我他妈绝不会让我的宝贝出任何事。

lines.en: : The disparity between how much you like your motorcycle and how much you like me is so great that I can’t even pretend to think you were referring to me as “your baby” just now.
lines.zh: : 你对你的摩托车和对我的喜爱程度差距之大，大到我连假装以为你刚才说的「我的宝贝」是指我都做不到。

lines.en: : Uh-oh. You goin’ cougar-hunting again? Things not work out for ya at the bar after last time? There’s an easier target right inside, you know. And that one’s only a {i}little{/i} bit older than-
lines.zh: : 哦哟。又去猎熟女了？上次在酒吧没成，所以换地方了？要知道里面就有个更容易的目标。而且那个{i}只{/i}比你——

lines.en: : Whatever, fine. I’m not here to go “cougar hunting.” I’m here to prove my masculinity. Plus, you wouldn’t be a cougar anyway because cougars actually {i}go after{/i} prey.
lines.zh: : 随便了，行。我不是来「猎熟女」的。我是来证明我的男子气概的。再说了，你本来也算不上熟女，因为熟女是真的会去{i}追{/i}猎物的。

lines.en: : All you do is pretend you don’t want to have sex with me.
lines.zh: : 你所做的，只是假装不想和我做爱。

lines.en: scene yukibikeride10
: Oh, come on man. You know damn well I’m just fuckin’ around and I wouldn’t-
lines.zh: : 哦，得了吧，老兄。你他妈清楚得很，我只是在开玩笑，我不会——

lines.en: : Yeah, whatever. Let’s just do this before I change my mind.
lines.zh: : 是，随便。趁我还没改主意，赶紧弄完吧。

lines.en: scene yukibikeride11
: You sure? Cause I ain’t stoppin’ once we’re on that thing.
lines.zh: : 你确定？因为一旦上了那玩意儿我可不会停。

lines.en: : I’m sure.
lines.zh: : 我确定。

lines.en: : Don’t have a helmet either. If we wipe out, we’re basically fucked.
lines.zh: : 而且我没有头盔。要是我们摔了，基本就完蛋了。

lines.en: : You should probably invest in a helmet if you’re going to be actively riding this thing, but yeah. I’m still in.
lines.zh: : 要是你打算一直骑这玩意儿，大概该投资一个头盔，不过，行。我还是去。

lines.en: : I’m trusting you, though. And I will not hide the fact that I am only doing this because I think it will increase the probability of you accepting my advances.
lines.zh: : 不过我把自己托付给你了。而且我不会掩饰——我做这件事只是因为我觉得它能提高你接受我追求的概率。

lines.en: : Luckily for you, we’re gonna have to get {i}real{/i} close on there. Hope you don’t pop a boner just from grabbing onto my waist.
lines.zh: : 算你走运，我们待会儿得贴得{i}很紧{/i}。希望你别只是抓着我的腰就硬了。

lines.en: : I make no promise. Now, let’s do this.
lines.zh: : 我不做任何保证。现在，开始吧。

lines.en: scene black
Yuki hops onto the bike and pats the space behind her for me to come sit down.
lines.zh: Yuki 跨上车，拍了拍她身后的位置，示意我坐上去。

lines.en: Up until now, I’ve successfully avoided ever having to do anything like this. And while I definitely {i}could{/i} have walked away tonight as well, I felt like I...shouldn’t for some reason.
lines.zh: 在此之前，我都成功地避免了任何类似的事。虽然今晚我当然也{i}可以{/i}转身走人，但我觉得自己……不知为何不该走。

lines.en: Call it a desperate lunge forward if you will — a chance to further myself in an area I have stagnated in for no reason other than to hopefully have sex with a student’s mother.
lines.zh: 你愿意称之为一次绝望的前扑也行——一个让我在停滞已久的领域往前走一步的机会，而理由不过是希望能和一个学生的母亲上床。

lines.en: It’s not a car.
lines.zh: 这不是汽车。

lines.en: I don’t know how it will make me feel and I don’t know how safe I will truly be.
lines.zh: 我不知道它会让我有什么感觉，也不知道自己到底有多安全。

lines.en: But it’s not a car.
lines.zh: 但这不是汽车。

lines.en: I tell myself that repeatedly as I sit down behind her and wrap my hands around her waist.
lines.zh: 我在她身后坐下、双手环住她的腰时，一遍遍这么告诉自己。

lines.en: scene yukibikeride12
: Comfortable?
lines.zh: : 舒服吗？

lines.en: : It’s not...the worst.
lines.zh: : 不算……最糟。

lines.en: Yuki starts slow and cruises through the neighborhood surrounding the bar at what I imagine is well below the speed limit.
lines.zh: Yuki 起步很慢，以我猜远低于限速的速度穿行在酒吧周围的街区。

lines.en: The sensation of the wind in my hair, while I’m sure it’s liberating for some, feels to me as if I’m being repeatedly pelted by the fists of a half-corporeal god.
lines.zh: 风吹过头发的感觉，虽然我确信对某些人来说那是自由的象征，但对我来说，就像被一位半实体神明的拳头反复捶打。

lines.en: It is there and it is tangible, though it moves right through me the way an arrow would if I was any good at thinking up metaphors on the back of a metal death trap.
lines.zh: 它确实存在，也确实可感，却径直穿过我，就像——如果我很擅长在一台金属死亡陷阱后座上想比喻的话——一支箭穿过我那样。

lines.en: : Just hang in there, aight? I don’t mind if you grab me a little bit tighter.
lines.zh: : 撑着点，好吗？你抓我抓得更紧一点我也无所谓。

lines.en: : I know I’ve been kinda flighty in the face of your “advances” lately, but I’m willing to make an exception while we’re on my bike.
lines.zh: : 我知道最近面对你的「追求」我一直有点躲躲闪闪，不过在车上我愿意破个例。

lines.en: : So it’s cool if we make out now?
lines.zh: : 那我们现在可以接吻了吗？

lines.en: : Sure, so long as you want to die. I’m good, but not “ride with my eyes closed” good.
lines.zh: : 行啊，前提是你是想死。我是很厉害，但还没厉害到「闭着眼睛骑车」。

lines.en: : If you wind up grabbin’ my tits on accident, though, I ain’t gonna kick the shit out of you.
lines.zh: : 不过你要是不小心抓到我的胸，我也不会把你揍个半死。

lines.en: : It’s not like there’s much to grab in the first place.
lines.zh: : 反正本来也没什么好抓的。

lines.en: scene yukibikeride13
: Oi, only I get to mock my chest. Ain’t cool when you do it. Just sounds like you’re tryin’ to compensate for somethin’.
lines.zh: : 喂，只有我能嘲笑我的胸。你嘲笑就不酷。听起来就像你在试图补偿什么。

lines.en: : Maybe I am.
lines.zh: : 也许我是在补偿。

lines.en: scene yukibikeride14
: Oh yeah? That shit Yumi say the other night about you havin’ a tiny dick have any truth to it?
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？那 Yumi 那天晚上说你鸡巴小，是真的吗？

lines.en: : Ain’t gonna hold it against you if she’s right. Ain’t cool to measure how much of a man someone is by the pistol they’re packin’.
lines.zh: : 就算她说对了，我也不会拿这个说事。用身上带的那把枪来衡量一个人有多男人，可不酷。

lines.en: : Oh, no. My penis is massive. But being back here does sort of emasculate me.
lines.zh: : 哦，不。我的阴茎很大。不过坐在后面确实让我有点不那么男人了。

lines.en: : Em...asculate? What’s that? That a sex thing? You ain’t gonna cum on my jacket, are you?
lines.zh: : 不那么……男人？那是什么？跟性有关吗？你该不会要射在我夹克上吧？

lines.en: : For lack of a better term, it makes me feel like a bitch.
lines.zh: : 找不到更好的说法——它让我觉得自己像个娘们。

lines.en: : A bitch? Nah. I don’t see it that way at all.
lines.zh: : 娘们？不。我完全不这么看。

lines.en: : A bitch would have...you know, bitched out. You’re tryin’ something new and you oughtta be respected for that.
lines.zh: : 娘们早就……你知道的，哭爹喊娘了。你在尝试新东西，这一点该被尊重。

lines.en: : Even if it means hanging onto the waist of someone who is both smaller than me {i}and{/i} a woman?
lines.zh: : 哪怕这意味着抱着一个比我矮、{i}还是{/i}个女人的腰？

lines.en: : The fuck’s bein’ a woman have to do with anything? You think you’re supposed to be bigger and stronger than me just cause you’ve got a dick? Nah.
lines.zh: : 是女人跟这有什么他妈关系？你以为就因为你有根鸡巴，你就该比我更大更强？不。

lines.en: : Maybe fifty years ago, but it don’t work like that anymore.
lines.zh: : 也许五十年前是，但现在不是这么运作的了。

lines.en: : I know. I’m just, and please excuse the pun, not in the backseat very often.
lines.zh: : 我知道。我只是，请原谅这个双关，很少坐后座。

lines.en: : So it makes me feel a little more submissive and...I guess more feminine than I’m used to. That’s what I meant by being emasculated.
lines.zh: : 所以这让我觉得自己更顺从、而且……大概比我习惯的更女性化一些。这就是我说的「不那么男人」。

lines.en: : Well, I still don’t know shit about this whole “emasculated” thing, but I really ain’t all that concerned about any of that “feminine or masculine” crap at the end of the day.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我还是不太懂这个「不那么男人」的东西，不过说到底，我真的不怎么在意那些「女性化还是男性化」的破事。

lines.en: : People are people, man. Why are we always assignin’ weird ass words and titles to ‘em when everybody’s different?
lines.zh: : 人就是人，老兄。明明每个人都不同，我们为什么总要把奇怪的词和头衔安在他们身上？

lines.en: : You think {i}I{/i} ever felt “feminine?” Nah. Been gettin’ shit for not bein’ {i}girly{/i} enough my whole life. Just look at me. But like, who even gives a shit?
lines.zh: : 你觉得{i}我{/i}什么时候觉得自己「女性化」过？从来没有。我这辈子都在因为不够{i}女人{/i}而被说。看看我这副样子。可是，操，谁在乎呢？

lines.en: : Not like it makes any sorta difference when we’re all just tryin’ to get by out here.
lines.zh: : 反正我们都是在这世上想办法活下去，这些并不会有什么区别。

lines.en: : If the world wants to think I’m not bein’ a “real” girl cause I’m sittin’ in the front while there’s a dude in the back holdin’ onto me, the world can go fuck itself.
lines.zh: : 如果这个世界想因为我坐在前面、后面有个男人抱着我，就觉得我不是「真正的」女孩，那这个世界可以去操自己。

lines.en: : All that shit’s just meant to keep us down, you know.
lines.zh: : 所有那些破事只是为了压着我们，你知道的。

lines.en: : Be this...Be that...Boys don’t cry...Girls play with dolls. All bullshit. If you want to cry, {i}fuckin’ cry.{/i} You want to play with dolls? {i}Play with fuckin’ dolls.{/i}
lines.zh: : 要这样……要那样……男孩子不哭……女孩子玩娃娃。全是废话。你想哭，就{i}他妈哭{/i}。你想玩娃娃？{i}就去他妈玩娃娃{/i}。

lines.en: : Don’t feel pressured to label yourself just cause you’re doin’ somethin’ people think is weird or different. All that’ll do is a paint a fuckin’ target on your back.
lines.zh: : 别因为自己做了别人觉得奇怪或不一样的事，就觉得有压力要给自己贴标签。那只会给你背上画个操蛋的靶子。

lines.en: : It’s like gangs, dude. Same people, same ideals — killin’ each other over fucking colors because that’s what they were told to do.
lines.zh: : 就像帮派，老兄。同样的人，同样的理念——为了操蛋的颜色互相残杀，因为别人就是这么教他们的。

lines.en: : People nowadays are so focused on bein’ a part of somethin’ that they’re missin’ out on all life has to offer.
lines.zh: : 现在的人太专注于成为某个东西的一部分，结果错过了生活能提供的一切。

lines.en: : We gotta stop forming teams and just accept that we’re all fuckin’ weird when it really comes down to it.
lines.zh: : 我们得停止组队，然后接受一个事实——说到底我们全都是他妈的怪人。

lines.en: : It ain’t our balls or tits that tell us how we’re supposed to be or act, its our brains and our hearts. And that shit looks the same no matter who you pull it out of. You know?
lines.zh: : 决定我们该怎样、该怎么做的，不是我们的蛋或者胸，而是我们的大脑和心。而那玩意儿不管从谁身上掏出来都一个样。你懂吧？

lines.en: : Yeah...but I’m a little surprised you went on such a heated rant about it based on one offhand comment I made.
lines.zh: : 是啊……不过我有点意外，我随口一句话居然能让你这么激动地长篇大论。

lines.en: : I just hate people thinkin’ they’re {i}supposed{/i} to be a certain way, you know?
lines.zh: : 我只是讨厌别人觉得他们{i}该{/i}是什么样子，你懂吗？

lines.en: : I like you cause you’re you. You don’t gotta be the fuckin’ 1950’s poster-boy for manliness. You’ve just gotta respect me and not make me feel like a piece of shit all the time. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你，因为你是你。你不必当什么操蛋的 1950 年代男子气概海报男。你只要尊重我、别老是让我觉得自己是一坨屎就行。就这些。

lines.en: : Should be that way for everyone...but we all just want to hate each other now.
lines.zh: : 本来每个人都该这样……可现在我们只想互相仇恨。

lines.en: scene yukibikeride15
: I don’t know. Maybe I’m just too old for this shit and I ain’t really gettin’ it or something.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。也许我只是太老了，搞不懂这些破事了。

lines.en: : Just know I ain’t gonna judge you for sittin’ back there. And I’d be hard pressed to think you’d judge {i}me{/i} for sittin’ up {i}here.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你只要知道，我不会因为你坐在后面而评判你。而我也很难想象你会因为{i}我{/i}坐在{i}前面{/i}而评判我。

lines.en: : Thank you for the motivational speech. I now no longer feel emasculated in telling you to keep your eyes on the road.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你这番励志演讲。现在我可以毫不「不那么男人」地告诉你：眼睛看路。

lines.en: scene yukibikeride16
: You got it, princess. Or {i}prince.{/i} Or whatever the fuck you want to call yourself cause they’re all the same exact fuckin’ thing. Same crown, different jewels. Feel me?
lines.zh: : 收到，公主。或者{i}王子{/i}。或者你他妈想怎么称呼自己都行，因为它们全都是同一个操蛋的东西。同样的王冠，不同的珠宝。懂我意思吗？

lines.en: : I...don’t think that’s accurate. Nor do I even know if princes and princesses even wear crowns?
lines.zh: : 我……不觉得这说法准确。我甚至不知道王子和公主到底戴不戴王冠。

lines.en: : I ain’t got a fuckin’ clue either. Just talkin’ outta my ass at this point. Feels good rantin’ to somebody for once, though.
lines.zh: : 我他妈也不知道。到这步我就是在瞎扯了。不过能对某个人发泄一通，感觉不错。

lines.en: : Ridin’ for me has always been a time to get my thoughts together. Everything always clogs up once I stop movin’, so the wind helps rattle my brain and make shit clear again.
lines.zh: : 骑车对我来说一直是整理思绪的时候。一停下来，所有东西就会堵死，所以风能把我的脑子晃一晃，让事情重新清晰起来。

lines.en: : Ain’t sure if you’ll ever wanna do this again after tonight, but...
lines.zh: : 不确定今晚之后你还想不想再来一次，不过……

lines.en: : Would be nice havin’ you.
lines.zh: : 有你在会挺好的。

lines.en: : I’ve barely even said anything, Yuki...
lines.zh: : 我几乎什么都没说啊，Yuki……

lines.en: : I know, I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道，我知道。

lines.en: : But the wind can get cold at night. And right now?...
lines.zh: : 但夜里风会很冷。而现在？……

lines.en: scene black
: You’re keeping me warm as fuck.
lines.zh: : 你把我暖得要死。

lines.en: scene yukibikeride17
: I’m going to puke.
lines.zh: : 我要吐了。

lines.en: : First ride’s always the hardest. You’ll do better on the way back.
lines.zh: : 第一次坐都最难。回去的时候你会好点的。

lines.en: : I’ll call us a taxi. I don’t think I can do that again.
lines.zh: : 我来叫辆出租车。我觉得我再也来不了了。

lines.en: : Ain’t gonna be able to fit Sara’s big ass espresso machine in a taxi.
lines.zh: : 出租车可装不下 Sara 那台大得要死的浓缩咖啡机。

lines.en: scene yukibikeride18
: But we can fit it on a motorcycle?...
lines.zh: : 可我们骑摩托车就能装下？……

lines.en: : Hell yeah we can. We’ll just ride carefully. Don’t have to worry about the roof of a car holdin’ us down. How’s your upper back strength? Need a quick massage?
lines.zh: : 当然能。我们小心骑就是了。不用担心车顶压着我们。你上背力量怎么样？需要快速按摩一下吗？

lines.en: : Right now is probably the only time in recent memory that I don’t want to be touched by you...or anyone, for that matter.
lines.zh: : 现在大概是最近记忆以来我唯一不想被你……或者任何人碰的时候。

lines.en: : Well, take a few minutes to catch your breath or whatever. But after that, we’ve gotta move our leg-hands.
lines.zh: : 行，那花几分钟喘口气什么的。不过之后，我们得动起腿和手了。

lines.en: : Oh no...Not you too...
lines.zh: : 哦不……连你也……

lines.en: scene yukibikeride19
: Come to think of it, you seen Kaori lately? Cause she’s been actin’ weird as shit the last few times I’ve called her.
lines.zh: : 说起来，你最近见过 Kaori 吗？因为我最近几次给她打电话，她都怪得要死。

lines.en: : Is she ever...{i}not{/i} weird?...
lines.zh: : 她有……{i}不{/i}怪的时候吗？……

lines.en: : Like...weird by even her standards. Which is probably hard to understand, but...I don’t know. Just keep an eye out for her, I guess.
lines.zh: : 就是……连她的标准来看都算怪。这大概很难理解，不过……我也不知道。总之帮我多留意她吧。

lines.en: : Worried all those jobs she has might finally be catchin’ up with her. Don’t want her burnin’ out.
lines.zh: : 担心她打的那堆工作终于要让她吃不消了。不想看她把自己烧干。

lines.en: : I’ll see what I can do...
lines.zh: : 我看看能做什么……

lines.en: scene black
After a few minutes go by and I’m still no better than when I first got off the bike, Yuki gets tired of waiting and drags me by the arm toward a restaurant supply store.
lines.zh: 几分钟过去了，我并不比刚下车时好多少，Yuki 等得不耐烦，拽着我的胳膊往一家餐厅用品店拖。

lines.en: As it turns out, a normal espresso machine (Which, might I add, is not a thing a bar even needs) just wasn’t going to cut it and Sara felt compelled to order the deluxe one instead.
lines.zh: 结果发现，一台普通的浓缩咖啡机（顺便说一句，酒吧根本不需要那种东西）根本不够用，Sara 非得订豪华款。

lines.en: And while I am in no physical or mental state to question this [[horrible] business decision of hers, I will say that it’s good to see she’s at least {i}trying{/i} to do something.
lines.zh: 虽然我在身体和精神上都没有状态去质疑她这个 [[horrible] 的商业决策，但我要说，看到她至少在{i}试着{/i}做点什么，这很好。

lines.en: What is {i}not{/i} good, however, is that it now falls on Yuki and me to get this thing all the way back to the bar...
lines.zh: {i}不{/i}好的地方在于，现在把这台东西一路弄回酒吧，落在了 Yuki 和我头上……

lines.en: And it is {i}very{/i} heavy.
lines.zh: 而它{i}非常{/i}重。

lines.en: $ yukidate25 = True
$ yuki_love += 1
{i}Yuki’s affection has increased to [yuki_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Yuki 的好感度提升到了 [yuki_love]!{/i}
